‘Dune’ Films Heading Back to Imax Theaters With an Exclusive ‘Dune: Part 3’ Sneak Peek

31 Oct 2026, 11:15 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: variety.com

Image: Jordan Moreau — Creative Commons

Key takeawaysFans of Denis Villeneuve's epic science-fiction franchise will have another opportunity to experience the saga on the big screen. Both previous installments of the "Dune" series are scheduled to return to Imax theaters next month, accompanied by an exclusive sneak peek

Fans of Denis Villeneuve's epic science-fiction franchise will have another opportunity to experience the saga on the big screen. Both previous installments of the "Dune" series are scheduled to return to Imax theaters next month, accompanied by an exclusive sneak peek of the upcoming conclusion, "Dune: Part 3."

According to the announcement, a special double feature showcasing both earlier films will play in Imax theaters for one night only on Nov. 13. Following the single-day double feature, individual showtimes for each film will run from Nov. 14 through Nov. 18, giving audiences a limited-run chance to revisit Arrakis before the trilogy's final chapter arrives.

Background and Franchise Success

Denis Villeneuve's adaptation of Frank Herbert's universe has proven to be both a critical and commercial powerhouse for Warner Bros. and Legendary. The first film, released in 2021, earned 10 Academy Award nominations and secured six wins, including categories for original score, sound, editing, cinematography, production design, and visual effects, alongside a Best Picture nomination.

The 2024 sequel continued that momentum, earning five Oscar nominations—including another Best Picture nod—and winning two awards for sound and visual effects. Commercially, the films have performed strongly at the global box office, with the first installment grossing $411 million worldwide and the sequel expanding that reach to $715 million.

What to Expect From 'Dune: Part 3'

"Dune: Part 3" is scheduled to release in theaters on Dec. 18, serving as the finale to Villeneuve's trilogy. The narrative jumps forward 20 years, following Paul Atreides after he has conquered most of the universe, setting up new conflicts and threats.

The cast features returning stars Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, and Javier Bardem. New and expanding additions to the ensemble include Robert Pattinson as the shape-shifting villain Scytale, Nakoa-Wolf Momoa and Ida Brooke as Paul and Chani's twin children Leto II and Ghanima, and Anya Taylor-Joy reprising her role as Alia Atreides following her cameo in the second film.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For moviegoers planning to catch the theatrical re-release, ticketing availability will depend entirely on local Imax theater participation and regional schedules for the Nov. 13 double feature and the Nov. 14–18 individual showtimes.

  • Confirmed Details: Both prior "Dune" movies will screen in Imax starting November 13 with a double feature, followed by single-film screenings through November 18. An exclusive preview of "Dune: Part 3" will be attached, and the final installment is slated to premiere on December 18.
  • Uncertainties: Specific theater locations, regional ticketing links, and the exact runtime or format of the "Dune: Part 3" sneak peek have not been comprehensively detailed for every market.
  • How to Verify: Readers can review the original coverage and updates on Variety and check local Imax cinema listings for confirmed showtimes and ticket availability.
